title: EVALUATING COLLECTIVE BEHAVIOUR OF HUNDREDS OF LLM AGENTS

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs to generate algorithmic strategies for multi-player social dilemma games (e.g., Public Goods Game, Common Pool Resource) under 'Exploitative' or 'Collective' attitudes, and analyzing their cooperation rates, social welfare outcomes, and strategic diversity through self-play simulations and cultural evolution modeling.
